children: Airbus said Egyptian airline Air Cairo had placed an order for 15 A320neo narrow-body aircraft as it seeks to expand its fleet.
The European plane maker didn't disclose financial details for the order, signed during the El Alamein International Airshow in Egypt.
Airbus said the order would allow Air Cairo to grow its fleet of over 45 aircraft as it aims for more than 130 aircraft by 2034.
